facts.text: Boys, wash your hands and line up. There will be a story after supper, and nobody goes to bed without one.
facts.why: Wendy does tell stories, but the Wikipedia plot gives no such line and no quote page could be opened. It reads as written for the menu, and it is printed in quote marks as if she said it.
facts.fix: Line up, boys, and wash your hands. There is a story after supper, if you can sit still.

fix_note.text: Line up, boys, and wash your hands. There is a story after supper, if you can sit still.

facts.why: I recall Skull Rock as Hook's lair where he holds Tiger Lily, not the Lost Boys' hideout, and this menu is the Lost Boys' Hideout. The pages opened do not mention Skull Rock for the film itself.
facts.fix: the rock where Hook holds Tiger Lily

facts.text: Ask the cook about: Mermaid Lagoon at night.
facts.why: The plot has the mermaids teasing Wendy and Hook rowing nearby, but no source opened gives the time of day. I recall the lagoon scene as bright, not night.
facts.fix: Ask the cook about: Mermaid Lagoon and the mermaids.

vibe.verdict: Good cardboard and badge look, but the food and the words stay generic for such a famous film.
